scripts.db:prepare-migration: pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --create-only --skip-seed && tsx src/post-migration.ts
scripts.db:deploy-migration: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:prepare-migration:staging: dotenv -e ../../.env.staging -- pnpm exec prisma generate && dotenv -e ../../.env.staging -- pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --create-only --skip-seed && tsx src/post-migration.ts
scripts.db:deploy-migration:staging: dotenv -e ../../.env.staging -- pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:deploy-migration:production: dotenv -e ../../.env.production -- pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.db:reset:staging: dotenv -e ../../.env.staging -- pnpm exec prisma migrate reset
